title: Process descendant tracking
responsibility: Tracks process identities by PID and start time through parent and anchored process-group observations, and signals only identities that still match.

inputs.name: processDescendants.root
inputs.description: PID of the command to track before it is reaped.

inputs.name: processDescendants.read
inputs.description: Optional process-table reader; defaults to the bounded system ps reader.

inputs.name: signalProcesses.known
inputs.description: Tracked PID/start-time identities to verify against a fresh process table.

inputs.name: signalProcesses.signal
inputs.description: Signal to send only to identities still matching the fresh process table.

outputs.name: processTable
outputs.description: Rows with PID, parent PID, process group and start time, or null when the bounded ps read fails or omits this process.

outputs.name: processDescendants
outputs.description: Tracker with look, survivors, alive and closed operations; parent-linked descendants are proven, group-only strangers are unproven.

outputs.name: signalProcesses
outputs.description: Resolves after signaling only supplied identities that still match; unreadable tables cause no signal and kill errors are ignored.
